mechanism.title: The Science Behind 4-7-8 Breathing
mechanism.description: The real culprit behind insomnia is often an overactive 'sympathetic nervous system'. The 4-7-8 method forces a rhythm change, sending safety signals down your vagus nerve.

items.title: Inhale 4s: Oxygen Intake
items.description: A slow, quiet inhalation begins to replenish your blood with fresh oxygen.

items.title: Hold 7s: Oxygen Exchange
items.description: The crucial step. Holding forces your heart rate to slow down, allowing oxygen to fully exchange in the lungs and enter the bloodstream.

items.title: Exhale 8s: Expelling CO2
items.description: The elongated exhalation directly activates the 'parasympathetic nervous system' (rest and digest), instantly giving you a profound sense of relaxation.

steps.label: Sleep Practice
steps.title: Try these 4-7-8 steps tonight
steps.description: Lie down in bed, relax your tongue (tip gently behind your upper front teeth), and let's begin.

items.title: Step 1: Quiet Inhale (4s)
items.description: Close your mouth and inhale quietly and smoothly through your nose, mentally counting to 4.

items.title: Step 2: Hold Breath (7s)
items.description: Hold your breath for 7 seconds. Let your body adapt to this pause, don't strain, keep it natural.

items.title: Step 3: Forceful Exhale (8s)
items.description: Exhale completely through your mouth, making a 'whoosh' sound for 8 seconds. This completes one cycle. We recommend 4 cycles per session.

faq.title: Questions about 4-7-8 Breathing

items.question: Melatonin stopped working for me, will breathing really help?
items.answer: Melatonin is a hormone supplement, whereas breathing is a direct physical hack to regulate your heart rate and autonomic nervous system (turning down sympathetic activity). Many develop melatonin tolerance, but breathing exercises offer long-term, side-effect-free physiological modulation.

items.question: How often should I practice 4-7-8?
items.answer: Beginners should do 4 complete cycles (about 1-2 minutes) twice a day. As you adapt, you can extend it up to 8 cycles. For sleep, doing it right after turning off the lights works best.

items.question: Is mild lightheadedness normal at first?
items.answer: Yes. When you first practice deep breathing, the altered ratios of oxygen and CO2 can cause temporary, mild lightheadedness. This is normal. If you feel uncomfortable, return to normal breathing and build up gradually.

items.question: Will running BreathWave overnight drain my Apple Watch battery?
items.answer: Not at all. BreathWave utilizes native, highly-optimized haptic APIs. You only run it for a few minutes to guide you into sleep, which has nearly zero impact on overnight battery life.

items.question: Does BreathWave offer other techniques besides 4-7-8?
items.answer: Yes! Alongside the ultra-calming 4-7-8 method, the app features Box Breathing (used by Navy SEALs), Tesla 3-6-9, and customized Wim Hof-style routines to match whatever state your body is in.
